mentions.name: RAG Boilerplate
mentions.description: Open-source RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) boilerplate with extensive system-design documentation, intended mostly for educational purposes. It includes propositional, semantic, and recursive overlap chunking; hybrid search on Qdrant (BM25 + dense) with optional LLM reranking; E5 embeddings as the default vector model; a query-enhancer agent built with CrewAI; a Celery-based document ingestion flow; session handling and restoration using Redis (hot) and MongoDB (cold); and a FastAPI backend with a small Gradio UI to test retrieval and chat with the data. Stack: FastAPI, Qdrant, Redis, MongoDB, Celery, CrewAI, Gradio, HuggingFace models, OpenAI.
